# Bundled asset licence notices

The files in [`licenses/`](licenses/) contain the complete upstream licence
text and copyright notice for every package recorded in
[`MANIFEST.json`](MANIFEST.json). The JavaScript and CSS distributions retain
their upstream headers where supplied; these adjacent notices also cover
minified distributions that omit a header.

The npm notices below were copied from the `LICENSE` or `LICENSE.md` file in
the pinned package tarball. The Inter notice comes from the upstream revision
embedded in the font metadata. No holder names or licence-template
placeholders have been substituted.

The four bundled Inter font files report `Version 4.001;git-66647c0bb` and
`Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors` in their name tables. Google
Fonts' metadata for that upstream revision identifies Rasmus Andersson as the
designer. The `world-atlas` package states that its topology redistributes
Natural Earth 4.1.0 vector data; Natural Earth declares that data public
domain.
